and you expect me to do something about: e espera que eu faca algo a respeito?

Sure. First you will need to toggle dock: Claro. Primeiro ative o modo de acoplagem clicando no icone da interface ou usando o

Hey would you look at that. You have a s: Olha so para isso. Voce tem uma estacao espacial, uma nave que pode criar, armas de sobra... ouso dizer que posso ignorar voce por um bom tempo agora.

You can only send so much power through:
You can only send so much power through a conduit at once. The amount you can send is determined by the rate statistic on the conduit, which is typically 10. This means that every update cycle, one way or another, you won't be able to send more than 10 units of energy through that conduit. 
  When modules use conduits, the first module to update may use all of the capacity of a conduit path, so it is good to optimize conduit designs by giving important modules their own unique connection to a source of power. The update order of modules is constantly randomized to prevent starvation over multiple updates, but an efficient conduit design should aim to reduce choke-points so modules aren't forced to take turns. Choke points are caused when multiple power-hungry modules find the shortest path to power is through a common junction. 
  Also note that power using modules can not draw power through other power using modules, they need a direct line of connection either to a reactor or a capacitor in order to draw power.
Reactors in Zero Falls don't require fue:
Reactors in Zero Falls don't require fuel, only proper management of their heat generation. The heat created relates to how much energy they produce during a ship's power update cycle. 
  The most important stat to consider is the reactor's Optimal Output. Every reactor can produce more energy than its Optimal output up to a point, however each point of energy produced beyond the optimal output incurs a double heat waste penalty. Here is a breakdown of what the stats mean. 
   
  Optimal Output - The ideal amount of energy produced each second after considering normal losses to heat. You should aim to draw this much power for ideal heat efficiency 
  
  Pre-waste Production - This is the raw energy output that the reactor is actually capable of. You don't actually get to use all of this energy because you lose some of the energy to heat, but it is useful for comparing reactors. 
   
  Heat Waste - This is the percentage of your energy production which will be lost to heat. You can probably ignore this stat when designing a ship, but it will help you compare two reactors on the basis of their efficiency because a higher heat waste value means a reactor which runs hot and will require a greater ratio of radiators to energy produced. 
  
  Optimal heat production - This is the amount of heat the reactor will produce if you are only drawing the optimal amount of energy from it. It can serve as a good guide for how many radiators you need to install. 
   
  Max heat production - This is the amount of heat the reactor will produce if you draw every single last unit of energy it is capable of producing, it provides an upper bound on how many radiators you can attach before additional radiators will become redundant. 
   
  Thermal Capacity - This is how much heat the reactor can store inside itself. 
   
  Thermal cutoff point - When the reactor has this much heat it shuts off power production as a safety measure. 
  
  Don't forget, reactors explode when damaged, so don't place them too close to your face!
The last phase of the power update cycle:
The last phase of the power update cycle is that of heat dissipation. Each radiator (if it is currently functional) has a certain amount of heat that it can remove each update. It performs a search along connected conduits for reactors with heat, and removes heat from any reactors prioritizing the first one found. This process requires a direct path along conduits to function, but unlike with power transmission does not use or compete with modules for capacitor bandwidth. 
   Note that only if the first reactor reaches zero heat will it continue searching for other reactors to remove heat from, so if you want to guarantee a reactor will get the cooling that it needs, make a closed circuit for cooling each reactor. Otherwise radiators may cool reactors unevenly leading to a hot design.

When terraforming operations on this pla: When terraforming operations on this planet were halted, they were already mostly completed. The operation was halted because of temporary belt conditions which had little to do with the planet itself. Thus, the uncolonized planet represents an enormous investment and has been placed under strict lockdown until the situation in the belts is resolved.
They have surrounded the entire planet w: They have surrounded the entire planet with an inertial dampening field so that movement between high orbit and the planet's surface can be completely controlled.
The region around the planet is divided: The region around the planet is divided into a series of security checkpoints, one after another, each containing security forces who have been tasked with guarding the planet against unauthorized entry.
Each checkpoint is guarded by a commande: Each checkpoint is guarded by a commander who alone holds the key to accessing the next sector. By defeating the commanders we should eventually be able to reach the final blockade before the planet itself.
Each checkpoint we pass also represents: Each checkpoint we pass also represents reaching a lower orbit closer to the planet's atmosphere, so we can expect security forces to get tougher and more numerous as we get further down.
Also, as I am sure you have already gues: Also, as I am sure you have already guessed, the security lockout regions are orbiting at different rates depending on their distance from the planet so we should expect to encounter different enemies every time we make an attempt. Almost as if these zones were part of a procedurally generated dungeon.
We are neither the first to attempt this: We are neither the first to attempt this, nor are we the last, so we should expect to find all sorts of interesting encounters along the way and we should take every opportunity that we can to repair and refit our ship in order to improve our odds of making it past the final blockade.

...and I swear that it made a face at me...a human face. It was mouthing some word, or at least that's what I remember seeing. Of course there's no way that's what really happened, grey goo isn't intelligent...as far as I know. Probably someone was playing a prank on me. Although...could you tell grey goo to construct a human? Wait, what if we are all just made of goo? Hmm, no I remember middle school and if I was made of goo I think I would have left those memories out when constructing me. Hold on, if goo can manipulate memories how do I really know what I remember? Did I actually know that goo can manipulate memories or was that just an implanted memory?...oh god did I just write all of this or was it the goo? Who even am I?
...
...I THINK I AM THE GOO...

Contains text:
Dear Diary,
Good news: Today the tooth that I found in my Snacks brand human chow was actually mine. The robo-doc fixed me right up and says I'm fit to continue eating Snacks brand suppliments for the rest of my life. In fact the computer was laughing and repeating just that "rest of your life" in my com channel until I muted it. I'm going to have to file for an AI attitude adjustment request in the morning.

Repair gun didn't have sufficient range to spray goo into the damaged module. "Build crew access so the ship can be repaired" that's what they teach at university, but these days they let anyone design a ship and everyone just wants more guns. Screw it, we can buy one of those disgusting nano-bug-bomb devices what hits the entire ship next time we are in port.

A standard issue repair lathe that uses: A standard issue repair lathe that uses glowing blue things to repair stuff. It smells mildly like ozone and it consumes grey goo in order to operate. It conveniently pulls goo out of a nearby cargo hold if there is none in your inventory.
A fancy leather jacket suitable for a ca: A fancy leather jacket suitable for a captain. You were born wearing it. Someone has good taste.
For some reason a single style of shirt: For some reason a single style of shirt has gained so much popularity that nearly everyone in the known galaxy can be found wearing one 7 days a week. Alien races often point out that the humans lack fashion sense, but usually not until they've made certain none are near by.
Old school black tank top. This one says: Old school black tank top. This one says "My arms are going to be wherever they like today, maybe even outside my shirt" and it is extremely popular among classy pirates. They have also recently gained popularity among armless aliens wanting to fit in among their shirt-wearing human friends.

Rich fertile land with an abundance of t: Rich fertile land with an abundance of the low value bulk minerals needed for a massive terraforming operation. This area was under active prospecting when terraforming operations were shut down.
Bigger pockets of valuable resources and: Bigger pockets of valuable resources and lower quantities of bulk materials made this belt less desirable for terraforming operations and more beneficial for commerce and the production of goods and services for terraforming workers.
Originally a mineral rich asteroid belt,: Originally a mineral rich asteroid belt, this region was drained of all valuable minerals during the early stages of terraforming. The process used genetically engineered synthetic crystals to transform the larger asteroids into inert crystalline husks and clouds of red dust which block nearly all useful solar radiation.
This mysterious region has been labeled: This mysterious region has been labeled as totally off limits by the SSC and all information regarding it is classified top secret.
The outer limits of the system, these va: The outer limits of the system, these vast ice fields at the edge of insterstellar space seem to indicate that the local star may have had a more violent past.
Continued development of this game broug: O desenvolvimento continuo deste jogo e oferecido a voce por odio, doenca mental e falacia dos custos irrecuperaveis. Visite nosso Discord se quiser ajudar a testar o multijogador.
This is dirt, also known as stuff you du: This is dirt, also known as stuff you dug up that isn't very valuable. However matter is matter, and matter is also energy, so why not throw it into the furnace and move on with your life?
Lead ore is boring, but heavy. Heavy mat: Lead ore is boring, but heavy. Heavy matter is good matter. It also converts easily into gold which is useful in ship construction.
It was once believed that these rocks we: It was once believed that these rocks were needed in order to grow crystals. However in modern crystal farms crystals are found to easily grow on dirt leading many to believe that we exist in a strange alternate universe where neutralino shards have never had any value at all.
An inert shard of a once living crystali: An inert shard of a once living crystaline life form. With some fancy genetic engineering it could be brought back to life. Use this on some dirt to plant a crystal with your currently configured genome.
A shard of crystal matter. This currency: A shard of crystal matter. This currency may be relevant in the future when the lazy good for nothing developers add that content to the game.
This energy dense byproduct of reactor f: This energy dense byproduct of reactor field collapse is so valuable that most mainstream manufacturers subsidize insurance payouts with the stuff. On purchasing a reactor, users agree to return the matter apon detonation of their drive. In practice however, both returns and claims are rare on account of fraud and the user-death invalidation clause.
A currency which allows unlocking module: A currency which allows unlocking module research.
This is a big pile of flesh that may or: This is a big pile of flesh that may or may not contain parts of clothing. For some reason this increases your station's capacity to produce space ships. The hope when writing this was that you would never read it so we wouldn't need to explain further.
Delicious Human Chow. Made for Humans, n: Delicious Human Chow. Made for Humans, not from Humans.
These are assorted parts and metal thing: These are assorted parts and metal things meant to replace failing components in a space station as well as for use constructing new stuff.
Troilite is a rare iron sulfide mineral: Troilite is a rare iron sulfide mineral which can be smelted to yield iron ingots.
Strands of gold wire ready for use in va: Strands of gold wire ready for use in various industrial applications.
Ilmenite is the titanium-iron oxide mine: Ilmenite is the titanium-iron oxide mineral which can be smelted to yield titanium Ingots.
This alloy is lightweight, heat resistan: This alloy is lightweight, heat resistant, and has excellent structural properties.
A natural form of graphite that occurs a: A natural form of graphite that occurs as small octahedral inclusions in iron-containing meteorites.
Also know as rocks, these silicon rich m: Also know as rocks, these silicon rich materials are still very useful for various forms of space production.
Refined silicate materials for use in va: Refined silicate materials for use in various industrial applications.
A refined, powder form, of pure elementa: A refined, powder form, of pure elemental carbon.
Microscopic carbon tubes, only a few ato: Microscopic carbon tubes, only a few atoms wide, with extreme tensile strength and low weight. Used in the creation of advanced materials and microscopic electronic components.
Carbon membranes. Their single atom thic: Carbon membranes. Their single atom thickness gives them special properties useful in the creation of advanced materials and microscopic electronic components.
Steel still has some of the best strengt: Steel still has some of the best strength characteristics and is very useful for space construction due to cost and availability.
These are assorted field coils. They mig: These are assorted field coils. They might be used to bend the fabric of space time allowing for the creation of infinite energy, or to heat up your coffee, depending on the specific application.
Computer chips, system boards, connector: Computer chips, system boards, connectors, sensors; this is just a big fun bag of those sorts of things.
Armor plates designed to protect against: Armor plates designed to protect against extremely high energy kinetic impacts.
Advanced ceramic meta-material plates wi: Advanced ceramic meta-material plates with excellent insulating properties designed to provide thermal shielding to the interiors of reactors, plasma conduits, and more.
Various arrangements of steel and titani: Various arrangements of steel and titanium designed to maximize structural support, minimize weight, and easily fit together into the various shapes needed for constructing ships or stations.
Before space-shipping it was common to i: Before space-shipping it was common to insure shipping crates against theft and damage. However, when interstellar shipping removed all forms of accountability, theft became an unmanageable problem and a new solution was needed. These days, molecular phase confinement is used to protect consumer goods by hiding their contents until they reach their final destinations, where they can be unpacked and stolen the old fashioned way by shoplifters.
Someone had the great idea that we could: Someone had the great idea that we could combine minerals and nano-particle construction material into a slurry with a batch of nano-construction bots. The result is a universal resource that can be used to construct or repair anything, though at a much higher cost than more traditional methods of construction and repair.
Use to form a colony and construct a sma: Use to form a colony and construct a small colony nexus where you can ressurect if you are killed. Be cautious because you only get one of these. If your colony nexus is destroyed you will have to join someone else in order to be a member of their colony.
Use from inventory to add this station t: Use from inventory to add this station to your colony and deploy it into space. This station increases your colony's capacity for additional stations by 3. Also, because every member you add to your colony can deploy a personal station your available station capacity is also your capacity to add new members to your colony
A defensive structure for your colony. T: A defensive structure for your colony. This station unlocks mass driver turret crafting for equipping your ships, and it also allows for the construction of automated defense turrets which can be placed in space around your colony to fend off intruders.
Use from inventory to add this station t: Use from inventory to add this station to your colony and deploy it into space. This station has DIRT! You can grow stuff on it.

Use from inventory to add this station to your colony and deploy it into space. This station must be deployed near an area where ore nodes spawn. It will periodically add resources to your colony resource storage
Use from inventory to add this station to your colony and deploy it into space. This station will add the ability for logistics inside your colony to package ships into an inventory item
Allows crafting of more advanced station: Allows crafting of more advanced stations and colony upgrades.
The shipyard is a better gathering locat: The shipyard is a better gathering location for players than the nexus as it has a nice restaurant in it and the station aggregates common crafting abilities from other stations allowing you to get all of your common crafting done in a single location where ships may also be produced.
The trade hub has many shops in it and b: The trade hub has many shops in it and by default anyone may list an item for sale at these shops, even those who are not a member of your colony. The shops are taxed at 10% and all tax proceeds are divided evenly among colony members.
Craft common trade goods and components: Craft common trade goods and components from raw resources. Also allows the construction of many new station types.
Relay stations extend the boundaries of: Relay stations extend the boundaries of your colony by allowing you to build inside of their radius the same as you would build inside of the radius provided by your colony nexus.
Each sensor tower increases the duration: Each sensor tower increases the duration of the warning period before your colony is attacked.
Place a refinary near a mining station i: Place a refinary near a mining station in order to increase all colony ore yield by 20%. You may only place 1 refinery per mining station
Like a regular farming station, but with: Like a regular farming station, but with twice as much farming!
The ultimate defensive station for your: The ultimate defensive station for your colony. It will allow you to craft a variety of defensive turrets
This station bolsters your nexus's defen: This station bolsters your nexus's defense by projecting a powerful energy shield around it. It will allow your nexus to survive attacks by One's fleet for slightly longer.
The Tinkerer's workshop allows you to cr: The Tinkerer's workshop allows you to craft basic tuning kits for your ships from trade goods and raw resources. You will be able to craft any tuning kit you have talents for.
Deploys a personal habitat station for t: Deploys a personal habitat station for the person who uses this item. The personal habitat station allows you to access your personal storage stash, a large private inventory for storing your junk. The size and layout of your personal station depends on what you have unlocked and selected as your preferred player housing style, or the default player housing if that feature hasn't been programmed yet.
Deploys the temporal research center: To: Deploys the temporal research center: Top secret technology with the power of making 2 way information sharing connections to other timelines. It will allow you to craft the devices needed to perform an ascension ritual.
Used for software and hardware penetrati: Used for software and hardware penetration, this device has 17 different types of radio, a neural interface link for rapid dissemination of acquired data, and the exterior is entirely composed of plugs that would allow it to be inserted into any known form of open data port. It can even deploy a set of probes for direct interface with exposed wiring. There is no need for you to know how hacking works, its internal quantum micro-computer is inhabited by an extremely greedy AI who wants to collect all of the data in the universe.
Although it has been prepared from ingre: Although it has been prepared from ingredients inside of a snacks brand human food suppliment pack, this meal has been nicely prepared. The meat flavored protein has been cooked, while the potato flavored starch has been rehydrated and the entire thing has been seasoned with various spices and herbs. Also, it turns out the gravy flavored chewing stick was actually dehydrated gravy. This meal provides the same amount of nutrition as an entire pack of snacks, while only taking half of a pack to make.
It is a masterpiece of a meal created in: It is a masterpiece of a meal created in a real kitchen. This is pretty much the limits of how far the nutritional value in a snacks brand suppliment can be stretched through presentation, preparation, and spice.
It's mostly algae cubes, but the spices: It's mostly algae cubes, but the spices and garnish really make this meal more satisfying to eat.
It is compressed pellets of algae in cub: It is compressed pellets of algae in cube form. It sort of tastes like grass blended with some walnuts. It isn't the most delicious food, but it is full of essential calories and protien. Maybe you should cook it into a more satisfying meal at a kitchen.
For the daring adventurer who needs to c: For the daring adventurer who needs to conquer their hunger on the move, try Snacks brand Snack Sticks. The same ethically-sourced flavored protein you've grown to love from Snacks brand human chow, now in the form of a convenient snack stick. Never miss another bite!
Don't have time to sleep right now? Send: Don't have time to sleep right now? Send it to the next level with PUMP brand extreme energy juice. PUMP the energy into your veins. Feel the burn of electric cherry flavor, now with glowing in the dark for a limited time only.
It is a cup of coffee. Finally everythin: It is a cup of coffee. Finally everything is right in the universe.
Can be made into coffee at any kitchen o: Can be made into coffee at any kitchen or galley.
It can be used to store fluids. Seasoned: It can be used to store fluids. Seasoned space captains always keep one of these near their command console in case nature calls during an intense space battle.
It is a bottle filled with a suspicious: It is a bottle filled with a suspicious fluid. You probably don't want to drink that. It can be converted to drinking water at the water recycling facilities of any galley or kitchen.
A rare treat. This one is neon green fla: A rare treat. This one is neon green flavor, everyone's favorite.
A fancy cocktail of drugs including anti: A fancy cocktail of drugs including antibiotics, antivirals, anti-parasitics, anti-fungals, anti-radiation meds, and vitimins. It'll cure what ails you.
Scraped from water ice and formed into a: Scraped from water ice and formed into a ball. You could eat it to keep hydrated, but you might expose yourself to weird space infections if you do.
Delicious space corn. It grows on a spac: Delicious space corn. It grows on a space cob.
Required by projectile turrets when relo: Required by projectile turrets when reloading. Place them into any of your ship's cargo bays in order to allow projectile turrets to reload. Different size turret mounts will require different amounts of ammo boxes to reload. Fixed = 1, Tiny = 2, Small = 3, Medium = 4, Large = 5, heavy = 6
Fully ready to be planted. This seed is: Fully ready to be planted. This seed is guaranteed to result in 1 adult space corn plant that can be harvested for 5-7 space corn.
It is a huge chunk of water ice. You sho: It is a huge chunk of water ice. You should probably find a way to sterilize it before attempting to drink it. If needed you can bludgeon this ice into snowballs which are easier to work with.
Some chunks which fell off of a space sh: Some chunks which fell off of a space ship for some reason. Did you shoot them? I bet this is your fault somehow.
Not just normal dust. This dust came fro: Not just normal dust. This dust came from outer space.

Can be used via inventory crafting to ad: Can be used via inventory crafting to add a random affix to a selected turret. Only one forging kit can be used per turret.
This sealed shipping crate is so well se: This sealed shipping crate is so well sealed that it can maintain its contents in an unobservable quantum wave-form state of being both in this box, and still sitting back on the shelf at the station where you loaded it. Thanks to the quantum temporal engineering capabilities of Zero, humanity's premiere logistical super intelligent AI, the contracting agency can guarantee that if you do end up stealing this crate in the future, then they never will have loaded it with any products in the past. Due to the volitile and unpredictable nature of contract shipping in space, all forms of valuable cargo transported within human space are secured this way. Return the empty crate to any station in order to get your deposit back.
A crafting material obtained by taking a: A crafting material obtained by taking apart ancient artifacts.
A crafting component used for player tra: A crafting component used for player trade skills. Drops from animated crew members of assimilated zombie ships controlled by One.
An advanced crafting component used in e: An advanced crafting component used in experimental colony stations. Can only be found inside a core hive.
An advanced crafting component used in experimental colony stations
An interdimensional lighthouse of sorts. It can be detected by itself across the multiverse creating a guiding path from which temporal geometry can be measured and plotted. You will need measurements from at least 5 points in real space in order to build a temporal map.
An encrypted data core. It contains tech: An encrypted data core. It contains technological specifications for advanced Shavala technology. If you had access to a quantum hyperintelligent AI you could probably use this to extract design specifications for some advanced technology. Used in the research center at your home station to craft tier 3 blueprints.
This wastes energy for a bit to demonstr: This wastes energy for a bit to demonstrate how research works. You can research it as many times as you like because it does nothing. Wastes 1 energy per second for 60 seconds
A civilian shuttle. Probably the least e: A civilian shuttle. Probably the least exciting ship you will see for a while.
SSC medium class transport ship sold on: SSC medium class transport ship sold on the open market
A light weight and fast T2 shuttle.
A light transport ship designed by SSC. It offers minimal defense but has excellent cargo capacity for its small size.
A medium transport ship designed by SSC. It offers a significant upgrade in cargo capacity compared to the Messenger, but without much more in the way of defense or speed.
A large, slow transport ship designed by: A large, slow transport ship designed by SSC. It's design is so popular that SSC has left it untouched for longer than anyone can remember, periodically updating the interior to fit modern aesthetic tastes.
Another modified shuttle. This one has a: Another modified shuttle. This one has a generally higher refinement of technology and a decently sized weapon.
A modern industrial transport modified t: A modern industrial transport modified to have lots of guns. More importantly it has been painted red.
SSC military spec Dagger class light cru: SSC military spec Dagger class light cruiser which probably should not be for sale, but do whatever you like, I'm a tool tip, what am I going to do?
A first generation SSC light cruiser des: A first generation SSC light cruiser design featuring tier 2 technology.
SSC military spec Dagger class light cru: SSC military spec Dagger class light cruiser which has been configured for sale on the open market
SSC military spec battlecruiser which sh: SSC military spec battlecruiser which should not be for sale here at all. It would almost certainly break some sort of regulation if you were to buy it.
A civilian multi-purpose transport ship: A civilian multi-purpose transport ship with excellent top speed and optional weaponry attachments.
A civilian industrial ship with above av: A civilian industrial ship with above average cargo capacity and decent forewards facing armor.
This station can manufacture a number of: This station can manufacture a number of civilian industrial type ships good for terraforming operations. The existing designs are good for moving personnel, transporting cargo, and asteroid mining operations. However, the station data banks also held designs for a light defense ship with some better weaponry. Those files have been corrupted and partially lost, but with some research they could be recovered.
This SSC destroyer is a variant designed: This SSC destroyer is a variant designed with many small turrets.
This is a heavily modified transport shi: This is a heavily modified transport ship that has been converted into a powerful battlecruiser by pirates. It features menacing red paint and lots of guns.
They have taken a standard light transpo: They have taken a standard light transport shuttle and attached guns to it. They also painted it red.
Honestly this is just a red version of o: Honestly this is just a red version of one of the most common ships in the sector. These ships were available in quantities dwarfed only by the availability of red paint. It features a single additional gun over the base variant.
A very nice industrial transport ship ha: A very nice industrial transport ship has had it's functional end torn out and replaced by a big turret and a lot of red paint. Nobody would suggest buying this.
A modified version of the Vulture, this: A modified version of the Vulture, this one has sacrificed a cargo bay to add a makeshift thrust over boost injector.
This is an SSC battleship. It is a terri: This is an SSC battleship. It is a terrifying and enormous battleship which should not be sold on the open market at all. Please stop buying it.
An old outdated weapons platform which c: An old outdated weapons platform which can still hold its own in a fight. It's design centers around a primative spinal weapon for launching unguided rockets. Due to its solid construction and reasonable price it's a favorite among violence loving civilians across the galaxy.
Backbone of the Seven Stars Coalition co: Backbone of the Seven Stars Coalition core fleet. These ships are relatively large, heavily shielded, and covered with guns.
A heavy and slow yet well armed civilian: A heavy and slow yet well armed civilian ship which comes standard with 4 tiny turret mounts and enough power generation to keep them firing.
A general purpose civilian transport bas: A general purpose civilian transport based on the dragonfly but considerably larger. This one comes standard with a repair drone bay and larger weapon mounts.
This civilian T2 medium industrial trans: This civilian T2 medium industrial transport has had almost all of its cargo space replaced with weaponry and shield equipment. The exterior has been painted in a pattern of tiny interlocking red hearts giving the ship a reddish pink color when seen from a distance. While the original design calls for smooth jazz to play on a constant loop through the PA systems, the provided audio tracks were automatically removed by an algorithm that detects pirated content.
This SSC arbalest class standoff support: This SSC arbalest class standoff support ship is simply filled with missile launchers. It has so many missile launchers that they had to make it the size of a battleship! It is a formidable warship indeed.
This SSC arbalest was clearly blown up a: This SSC arbalest was clearly blown up at some point in the past because half of it is missing. However what remains is still a formidable warship. After being salvaged, what remained of the ship was painted red and covered with spooky skull markings by the famous ship artist formerly known as Greg.

This SSC arbalest was clearly blown up at some point in the past because half of it is missing. However what remains is still a formidable warship. After being salvaged, what remained of the ship was painted red and covered with spooky skull markings by some idiot formerly known as Greg. It was then upgraded by your best pal Gary and now it sports some fine-ass heart shaped decor.
This civilian Vulture class light transp: This civilian Vulture class light transport may be old technology, but the protected position of its bridge, interior layout which places non-essential modules near the front, low profile, good speed, and above average armament makes it a favorite among those looking for an entry level combat ship.
This light fighter designed for use by t: This light fighter designed for use by the elite Shavala navy of Kuvera has a significant edge over other fighters of the same weight class because the advanced military technology miniturization of Kuveran design allows even light fighters to carry regenerative shields and advanced composit armor.
Small corvette hull used by the Shavala: Small corvette hull used by the Shavala navy.

Reactors used to have a fun flavour text:
Reactors used to have a fun flavour text description but someone complained. Here's how they work:

Reactors generate energy on-demand and if no energy is used, no heat is generated. They have a base output but they lose some of that energy to heat before you can ever use it. They also always have an optimal running output. Any energy that is used beyond the optimal output experiences a double heat penalty, so if you plan to place a heavy load on your reactors it is a good idea to have extra radiators. Different reactors create and store different amounts of heat, so small reactors are easier to cool than large ones, but when they get to 100% heat capacity they explode, so every reactor has a cut-off point where it shuts down before overheating.
